description: This file provides utility functions for managing media storage in a FastAPI context, including directory setup, safe filename generation, file path creation avoiding collisions, saving uploaded files asynchronously, and retrieving media directories.

methods.name: None ensure_media_dirs()
methods.description: Ensures that the base media storage directories (media, videos, subtitles) exist.

methods.name: str _safe_filename(name: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by removing unsafe characters, replacing spaces with underscores, and trimming.

methods.name: Path build_unique_path(directory: Path, base_name: str, ext: str, prefix: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Generates a unique file path within the specified directory, avoiding existing files by appending a counter.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[bytes] _iter_upload_chunks(file: UploadFile, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024)
methods.description: Asynchronously reads chunks from an uploaded file, yielding each chunk.

methods.name: None save_upload_file(file: UploadFile, dest_path: Path, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024)
methods.description: Asynchronously saves an uploaded file to a specified destination path, creating parent directories as needed.

methods.name: Path get_video_dir()
methods.description: Returns the directory path where videos are stored.

methods.name: Path get_subtitle_dir()
methods.description: Returns the directory path where subtitles are stored.

ctags.name: build_unique_path
ctags.pattern: /^def build_unique_path(directory: Path, base_name: str, ext: str, prefix: Optional[str] = None) -/
ctags.signature: (directory: Path, base_name: str, ext: str, prefix: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: save_upload_file
ctags.pattern: /^async def save_upload_file(file: UploadFile, dest_path: Path, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024) -> /
